paths.name: vscode-languageclient
paths.message: The bare vscode-languageclient entry is its Node build. Import types only from shared code; values come from vscode-languageclient/node in src/node/ or vscode-languageclient/browser in src/browser/.

patterns.message: Node APIs are only allowed in src/node/. Shared code must run in the Web Worker host too - see AGENTS.md.
vscode-languageclient/node reaches child_process: only src/node/ may import it - see AGENTS.md.
vscode-languageclient/browser is the Web Worker transport: only src/browser/ may import it.
vscode-languageclient/browser is the Web Worker transport: only src/browser/ may import it.
